benchmark_matrix_recommended.note: Do not assume 8 workers beat 4 or 6 on a thermally constrained Apple Silicon machine; measure, including Efficiency-core placement effects.

description: P0 evidence-derived optimization sequence. No implementation in P0. Each item states what changes, why faster, invariant, parity test, rollback.

sequence.expected_benefit: near-linear wall reduction on N cores for multi-state workloads (the 281-run class)
sequence.parity_test: P0 fixture hashes bit-identical at workers 1/2/4/N; eligibility/refusal/counts/frequencies/distributions/orders identical
sequence.rollback: any parity mismatch or sublinear collapse with no diagnosis -> serial fallback (one flag)
sequence.scientific_invariant: per-state inputs and per-sim streams unchanged; assembly order-independent
sequence.what: outer multiprocessing over independent states (candidate A), with within-run future chunking (candidate C) for load balance
sequence.why: 277-state workload is embarrassingly parallel; RNG keyed by scientific identity so any worker/order yields identical outputs

sequence.expected_benefit: large single-process factor: ~70-80% of profiled time is call/allocation/validation overhead around simple arithmetic
sequence.parity_test: bit-identical P0 fixture hashes + targeted unit parity (event order, drift table, sampler vectorization, heap queue)
sequence.rollback: any hash mismatch -> revert component-wise (each sub-item independently revertible)
sequence.scientific_invariant: identical arithmetic in identical order; identical RNG consumption order; identical event order
sub_items: hoist run-fixed validation/scale (validate_rho 3x/step -> 1x/run; innovation_scale sqrt hoisted)
mutable per-driver mechanism state instead of frozen-dataclass rebuild per step (same field updates)
precomputed per-driver drift table over laps_ahead (exact same values)
vectorized sampler over the per-sim uniform pool (verify np.interp bit-identity)
heap event queue with (time, driver_id) tie-break (exact same event order)
sequence.what: eliminate per-event Python overhead without changing arithmetic or order
sequence.why: profile: 5.6M schedule calls/run dominated by dataclass churn (16.4s), repeated validation (6.1s), scalar interp dispatch (14.9s), queue scans (17.4s min/sorted/dict)

sequence.expected_benefit: additional factor on top of P2 for the residual arithmetic-bound portion
sequence.parity_test: bit-identical fixture hashes required; any float-order deviation needs separate scientific justification first (not assumed)
sequence.rollback: any parity deviation -> keep P1+P2 only
sequence.scientific_invariant: same operations in same order per element; same RNG consumption; same event/order semantics
sequence.scientific_risk: MEDIUM (float association/order and event-order coupling need proof)
sequence.what: exact NumPy vectorization across simulations for pace/drift/residual arithmetic
sequence.why: per-event arithmetic is pure; event loop ordering is the only coupling
